query: How do I tell the city folks about broken traffic lights in TN?
reference_answer:
Reporting Traffic Signal Malfunctions:
To report traffic signal malfunctions in Tamil Nadu cities, call the police control room (100) or contact the local traffic police station. You can also use the Tamil Nadu Police Department's mobile app or website to report the issue.
answer: To inform city folks about broken traffic lights in TN, contact local government offices or use social media platforms to report the issue. [Document N] is not available for this information.
